messages:
emma_support: Hey team — customer ACME reporting errors when calling our tool endpoint in JSON mode. Root error: schema validation failed for function call args. They say the 'items' field is coming through as a string ("[...]") not an array. logs attached.

devon_runtime: Can you paste the request payload + request_id? Also which SDK and model? :eyes:

acme_integration: Here's our payload (we're using node sdk 1.3.0):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood/gpt-infer-std",
  "json_mode": true,
  "function_call": {
    "name": "process_order",
    "arguments": {
      "order_id": "ORD-123",
      "items": "[ { \"sku\": \"A1\", \"qty\": 2 } ]"
    }
  }
}
```

emma_support: runtime response:
```
400 Bad Request
{"error":"function args failed schema validation","details":{"items":"expected array, got string"}}
```

maya_ml: That payload is the issue — items is a JSON-encoded string. Does the SDK auto-stringify arrays before sending? Which client method are you using?

devon_runtime: I pulled the request_id (req_2140539876) and full raw request. Looks like the customer's middleware serializes nested objects into form-urlencoded body for other calls and reuses it here — content-type was application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

oliver_oncall: @devon_runtime can you confirm whether our runtime had any recent change to accept form bodies for function calls? If not, this is user-side bug but we should return a clearer error.

devon_runtime: No change on our side. We should still require application/json for structured function args. I'll add a clearer error and a pointer to docs. @emma_support please give customer repro command.

emma_support: repro curl I asked ACME to run:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/completions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-infer-std","json_mode":true,"function_call":{"name":"process_order","arguments":{"order_id":"ORD-123","items":[{"sku":"A1","qty":2}]}}}'
```

acme_integration: When we send Content-Type: application/json it works. We accidentally had a proxy that coerced JSON bodies to strings when using their legacy integration.

maya_ml: OK that's the root cause. Two action items:
- Support: document the error message and add hint about content-type and stringified nested fields
- Runtime: add validation to detect common "stringified JSON array" patterns and return an explicit message pointing to content-type or suggest parsing

devon_runtime: I'll open infra ticket to improve error clarity and add a quick guard in the next minor release. Filed INFRA-4821. Assigning @oliver_oncall for release.

oliver_oncall: ack. I'll schedule a patch. In the meantime, @emma_support can you ask ACME to patch proxy or upgrade to node sdk 1.4.x which preserves nested JSON bodies.

emma_support: Confirmed customer will update proxy. ACME — please ping here once deployed so we can close. :thumbsup:

acme_integration: Deployed, verified — no more 400s. Thanks for the help!

emma_support: Closing once we get final telemetry. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
